brief: Eleven audit-led additions: nine Legendary, two Rare; seven Attack, two Defense, two Support. Existing records and portraits stay unchanged.

champions.name: Odravic, Frostblood Duelist
champions.title: The Winter Challenge
champions.lore: Odravic keeps the Bloodcourt’s winter dueling ground, where every oath is spoken over a frozen rose. His frostglass rapier parts enchanted defenses as neatly as silk. He offers every challenger one courtesy: the chance to surrender before the ice reaches their heart.
champions.gap: Bloodcourt Blue previously had only the charging Legendary Lysandre; adds a Fast focused Dispel striker.

champions.name: Svanhild, Aurora Thorn
champions.title: Keeper of the Winterbriar
champions.lore: Svanhild guards the living pines beyond Frost’s last watchtower. She learned to bind the green aurora into winter thorns after raiders burned the forest’s oldest shrine. Her glaive leaves a cold, branching wound through which no fresh enchantment can take root.
champions.gap: Frost Green previously had only Common Beastmaster Gharn; adds a Fast Legendary attacker with a brief Buff Seal.

champions.name: Zephyrax, Eclipse Hunter
champions.title: The Moonless Pursuit
champions.lore: Zephyrax hunts the creatures that slip between Umbra’s ruined observatories during an eclipse. He tempers his spear in the lightless frost beyond the stars, where armor remembers that it was once dust. Those who hear his footsteps have already lost the trail home.
champions.gap: Umbra Blue previously had only Common Hooded Thrall; adds a focused Fast Legendary Pierce attacker.

champions.name: Phelune, Duskpetal Keeper
champions.title: Lantern of the Violet Grove
champions.lore: Phelune tends the violet flowers that open only when Wildgrove’s oldest trees begin to dream. Their pollen draws poison and curses from wounded travelers, leaving a faint silver glow along the scars. She asks for no payment beyond a seed planted on the road ahead.
champions.gap: Adds a second Purple Wildgrove choice and a scarce Purple Rare Support: modest Fast team healing and Cleanse.

champions.name: Zhaoren, Amethyst Sentinel
champions.title: Watch of the Western Gate
champions.lore: Zhaoren stands watch where the Dragon Dynasty’s western gate opens onto a valley of amethyst. He carries a shield cut from its first guardian stone, polished smooth by generations of patient hands. When the alarm sounds, he steps forward so that everyone behind him has time to breathe.
champions.gap: Dragon Dynasty had only two defenders, three Rares and one Purple member; adds an accessible Average tank.

champions.name: Marzahin, the Mirage Tide
champions.title: Blade of the Hidden Wells
champions.lore: Marzahin guides the Dune Riders between wells that appear on no map. The water he carries remembers the sea that once covered the desert, and answers his blade with a sudden, crushing undertow. He leaves his enemies chasing reflections while the caravan passes safely beyond the dunes.
champions.gap: Dune Riders Blue previously required Mythical Nayara; adds an accessible Legendary Fast attacker.

champions.name: Kryzzik, the Cinderclaw
champions.title: The Furnace-Bred Hunter
champions.lore: Kryzzik escaped the Chymera’s furnace vats with molten blood and a hunter’s perfect patience. Its ember-lined claws strike once before it vanishes into the heat shimmer. The alchemists still debate whether the creature was their finest experiment or the first thing they should have feared.
champions.gap: Chymera Red previously had only Slow Legendary Kaitha; one-turn Burn is budgeted for the faction extension.

champions.name: Gavrox, the Void Foundry
champions.title: Master of the Null Crucible
champions.lore: Gavrox built the Ironclad’s first crucible capable of forging metal in a vacuum. The silence trapped inside its shells follows every impact, smothering the rhythm of enemy spellwork. He considers each battlefield a difficult workshop and every surviving ally proof that the design can be improved.
champions.gap: Ironclad Purple previously had only Torvek; adds an Average area attacker with limited one-turn control.

champions.name: Iskavelle, Verdigris Oath
champions.title: The Briar-Gate Vow
champions.lore: Iskavelle swore to keep the Bloodcourt’s briar gate after its living guardians withered. Green veins now run through her bronze shield, carrying the old grove’s promise into every battle. She shelters her companions beneath its woven wards, then dares their enemies to face her alone.
champions.gap: Bloodcourt Green previously had only Valcera; adds scarce Green Legendary defense and team protection without revival.

champions.name: Yrsa, the Sunfrost Spear
champions.title: First Light on the Glacier
champions.lore: Yrsa climbs the eastern glacier before dawn to catch the first sunlight in the ice of her spear. Frost’s scouts follow that golden point through storms that swallow every other beacon. When she casts it, a winter’s worth of gathered light reaches the enemy in a single stroke.
champions.gap: Frost had no Yellow attacker; adds a straightforward Fast burst option without overlapping Eira’s support role.

champions.name: Huying, Lantern of Clear Skies
champions.title: The Unclouded Covenant
champions.lore: Huying carries the Dragon Dynasty’s lanterns through battlefields thick with hostile enchantments. Each flame burns with a promise made beneath a clear sky, washing curses from her companions and restoring the rhythm of their spellwork. When the lanterns rise together, even the shadows between them become a shelter.
champions.gap: Adds the first Yellow Dragon Dynasty support, emphasizing purification, a brief Barrier and matching-mana flow instead of another team healer.
